reforms.description: The Canadian government implemented a series of capital-incentive measures, including a loan fund of CJ 150 million to be distributed to provinces based on unemployment levels for job-creating capital projects, capital-incentive grants to stimulate investment in the private business sector, and a 10 percent tax credit on purchases of new machinery and equipment produced in the United States to incentivize domestic investment in capital goods.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These measures are designed to stimulate investment and job creation, which can enhance productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The measures have been put into effect as part of the government's economic strategy.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant but narrower changes aimed at stimulating investment in the economy.
reforms.source_quote: a special programme was launched to finance capital projects in regions of slower economic growth, and there was a further increase in transfer payments to provinces.
